questions.stem: One Monday morning, while the children were enjoying “free play”, I stepped to the doorway of the classroom to take a break. Suddenly, I ____1____ a movement of the heavy wooden door.
questions.analysis: 本题考查动词词义辨析。题干描述的是作者在教室门口休息时，突然注意到沉重的木门有动静。根据语境，这里需要一个表示“看到、注意到”的动词。选项A. caused（引起）不符合语境，因为门不会自己引起动作；B. spotted（发现、注意到）符合语境，表示偶然看到或察觉到；C. checked（检查）需要主动去查看，而这里是突然的发现；D. imagined（想象）与事实不符，因为门确实有动静。因此，正确答案为B。解题思路：结合上下文，理解动作的突发性和感知性，选择最贴切的动词。

questions.stem: This was the very door I ____2____ guided the children through to ensure their safety from the bitter cold.
questions.analysis: 本题考查副词词义辨析及语境理解。题干意为“这正是我____引导孩子们穿过的那扇门，以确保他们免受严寒之苦。”空格处需填入副词修饰动词“guided”，描述引导的方式。选项A. hesitantly（犹豫地）不符合语境，因为引导孩子穿过门是为了安全，不应犹豫；选项B. randomly（随机地）与确保安全的目的矛盾；选项C. dizzily（头晕地）不合逻辑；选项D. carefully（小心地）符合语境，即小心引导孩子穿过门以避寒。语法上，副词修饰动词，位置正确。解题思路：根据后文“ensure their safety”推断引导行为应是谨慎的，故选D。

questions.stem: It was one of my kindergarteners who I thought was ____3____ that day.
questions.analysis: 本题考查强调句和形容词辨析。题干为强调句型'It was...who...'，强调主语'one of my kindergarteners'，其中'who I thought'为插入语，表示'我认为'。句子主干为'It was one of my kindergarteners who was ____ that day'，意为'那天是我认为的一个幼儿园孩子____'。选项A. angry（生气的）、B. absent（缺席的）、C. special（特别的）、D. noisy（吵闹的）。根据语境，'that day'暗示具体某一天的状态，且'kindergartener'（幼儿园孩子）通常与'absent'（缺席）搭配合理，表示孩子那天没来。其他选项虽语法正确，但逻辑上不如'absent'自然。解题思路：先识别强调句型，去掉插入语'who I thought'，得到'It was one of my kindergarteners who was ____ that day'，再结合常识判断幼儿园孩子当天可能的状态。语法点：强调句型结构'It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 其余部分'；词汇用法：absent常与表示时间或场合的词语连用，如'absent from school'。

questions.stem: This five-year-old taught me a powerful lesson in _____10_____ .
questions.analysis: 本题考查名词词义辨析及语境理解。题干中“This five-year-old taught me a powerful lesson in _____10_____”意为“这个五岁的孩子给我上了关于_____的深刻一课”。选项A. gratitude（感激）B. forgiveness（宽恕）C. faith（信念）D. kindness（善良）。根据常见语境，孩子教给成年人的往往是简单而深刻的道理，如感恩、善良等。但结合“powerful lesson”和“five-year-old”的对比，通常强调孩子纯真无邪的品质，如感恩（gratitude）或善良（kindness）。然而，在高考真题中，此题常出自完形填空，上下文可能暗示孩子对某事的感激之情。解题思路：需结合上下文语境，若前文提到孩子收到帮助或礼物，则“gratitude”最合适；若无上下文，则需根据常见搭配“lesson in gratitude”更自然。语法点：介词“in”后接名词，表示“在……方面”。词汇用法：gratitude为不可数名词，常与express/show/teach搭配。因此，答案选A。

Here are five ways to sustain (保持) long-distance friendships. ·Set a regular dateLong-lasting friendships share the characteristic that both sides equally contact (联系) and share with one another. With busy schedules, squeezing in phone calls can be a challenge. ___16___. ·More isn’t always merrierMake sure you have communicated with your friend about how frequently each of you wants to be contacted and what method works best for you both. ___17___. There are alternatives to constant written communication, such as leaving voice messages or having a group chat. ·Practise empathy (共情)___18___. The friend who is remaining needs to be sensitive to all the additional time demands placed on the friend who has moved. The one in the new environment should be sympathetic to the fact that your friend may feel abandoned. · ___19___ Anniversaries and birthdays carry even more weight in long-distance friendships. Although technology might make day-to-day communication possible, extra effort goes a long way on special days. Simply keeping a diary that keeps track of friends’ birthdays and other important dates will make sure nothing slips by you. ·Don’t rely on technology alone___20___, but long-distance friendships — even close ones — may require more conscious effort to sustain. Try to seek out chances to renew friendships. How to do it? Just spend face-to-face time together whenever possible.A. Remember important datesB. Compensate by writing lettersC. It is also helpful for you to be a friendship keeperD. Try to find a time that works for both of you and stick to itE. Friends need to talk about their preferred methods of communicationF. It is easy to have a sense of connectedness through social mediaG. You may be the friend who left or the one who was left behind
options: C. It is also helpful for you to be a friendship keeper
D. Try to find a time that works for both of you and stick to it
E. Friends need to talk about their preferred methods of communication

G. You may be the friend who left or the one who was left behind

questions.stem: Students will be deregistered if ________.
options: A. they send emails in error
B. they fail to work interactively
C. they give their places to others
D. they miss two sessions in a row
questions.analysis: 本题考查条件状语从句的省略和语境理解。题干中'if'引导条件状语从句，主语'Students'与从句主语一致，且从句谓语为被动语态时，可省略'if they are'，但此处从句为主动语态，需完整表达。选项D 'they miss two sessions in a row'（连续缺席两次）符合常见学校注册规定，即连续缺课可能导致注销学籍。语法点：条件状语从句的时态（一般现在时表将来）。词汇用法：'deregistered'（注销注册）、'in a row'（连续地）。解题思路：根据常识判断，学校通常因学生连续缺课而注销其注册，其他选项（误发邮件、未互动、转让名额）均不构成典型注销原因。

options: A. Fitness levels decide the quality of life.

questions.analysis: 本题为七选五阅读理解题，考查上下文逻辑衔接和语篇理解。题干段落首先提出“我们需要健康才能拥有健康的身体”，接着用“Similarly”引出“如果我们健康，自然会倾向于保持身体健康”，然后解释健康是身体在特定时间的状态，并指出即使没有疾病也可能身体虚弱。选项B“Health and fitness are interrelated to each other”（健康与健身是相互关联的）与题干中的“Similarly”逻辑一致，强调健康与健身的相互关系，且后文进一步阐述健康状态与身体虚弱的关系，符合上下文连贯性。其他选项：A讨论健身水平决定生活质量，与后文不直接衔接；C提到保持冷静和放松，与主题无关；D举例容易感冒，但题干未提及具体疾病；E说保持健身能更好享受生活，与后文逻辑不符；F提出一些活动，无上下文支持；G说身体受苦会得其他疾病，与题干最后一句“ready to be targeted by viruses”有部分关联，但不如B直接点明健康与健身的关系。解题思路：先理解段落主旨，注意“Similarly”提示前后句的并列或递进关系，再分析选项与上下文的逻辑衔接。语法点：词汇“interrelated”意为“相互关联的”，是解题关键。

questions.stem: 阅读下面短文，根据题目要求用英文回答问题。Tom, a 15-year-old inventor and entrepreneur (创业者), witnessed at his own school the widespread consumption of sugary drinks by kids. options: A. Fitness levels decide the quality of life.
B. Health and fitness are interrelated to each other.
C. It also helps in keeping us calm and relaxes our mind.
D. For instance, we may have a tendency to catch a cold easily.
E. If we keep our body fit, we can enjoy life in a better manner.
F. There are some activities which everyone should do in our life.
G. This makes our body suffer and we will catch other diseases.
questions.analysis: 本题为七选五阅读填空题，考查上下文逻辑衔接和语义连贯。题干前文提到睡眠有助于改善免疫系统、预防疾病，后文提到“这反过来给我们带来健康与健身的新目标”。选项C“它也有助于让我们保持冷静并放松心情”中的“also”与上文“helps in improving”形成并列关系，且“keeps us calm and relaxes our mind”与“relax our body”呼应，逻辑顺畅。其他选项：A谈论健身水平决定生活质量，与上下文无关；B说健康与健身相互关联，但未直接衔接；D举例容易感冒，与前文“预防疾病”矛盾；E说保持健康能更好享受生活，偏离睡眠话题；F说有些活动每个人都应做，过于宽泛；G说身体受苦会得病，与前文正面描述不符。因此C正确。

questions.stem: 假定英语课上老师要求同桌之间交换修改作文，请你修改你同桌写的以下作文。文中共有10处语言错误，每句中最多有两处。每处错误仅涉及一个单词的增加、删除或修改。增加：在缺词处加一个漏字符号(^)，并在其下面写出该加的词。删除：把多余的词用斜线(\\)划掉。修改：在错的词下划一横线，并在该词下面写出修改后的词。注意：1．每处错误及其修改均仅限一词;2．只允许修改10处，多者(从第11处起)不计分。We all know that cycling is a greatly exercise. A doctor tells me people who lives the longest are dancers and cyclists. Maybe it is because the combination of fresh air, smooth movement and exercise. Whether you ride a bicycle, you don’t use petrol. So they are not producing carbon dioxide and not cause air pollution. Just see how cars have been taken over our cities. They often run at high speeds, what may put our lives in danger. And there were traffic jams, too. Our cities will be better places if we replace cars with bicycle.
questions.answer: 1. greatly → great; 2. lives → live; 3. because后加of; 4. Whether → When/If; 5. they → it; 6. cause → causing; 7. have been taken → have taken; 8. what → which; 9. were → are; 10. bicycle → bicycles
questions.analysis: 本题考查短文改错，涉及形容词、主谓一致、介词、连词、代词、非谓语动词、语态、定语从句、时态、名词复数等知识点。

questions.stem: 学校英文报正在开展以Learning English Beyond the Classroom为题的讨论。请使用图表中的调查结果写一篇短文投稿，内容包括：1. 学习活动状况描述：2. 简单评论;3. 你的建议。注意：1 词数100左右;2. 短文的题目和首句已为你写好。[图片10_1]

questions.answer: the opportunities that Fun Bottle presents to others
questions.analysis: 该句错误部分为“the opportunities that Fun Bottle presents to others”。语法点：定语从句中关系代词that引导的从句修饰先行词opportunities，但presents to others搭配不当，应为presents to others with opportunities或直接使用presents opportunities to others。词汇用法：presents sth. to sb. 是固定搭配，意为“向某人提供某物”，但此处presents to others缺少宾语，导致结构不完整。解题思路：分析句子结构，发现主句为Tom is most proud of the opportunities，定语从句that Fun Bottle presents to others中presents缺少直接宾语，应改为that Fun Bottle presents to others with或that Fun Bottle presents to others (省略that)。因此，错误部分为“the opportunities that Fun Bottle presents to others”，需将其改为“the opportunities that Fun Bottle presents to others with”或“the opportunities that Fun Bottle presents to others”。

questions.analysis: 本题为应用文写作，要求写一封邀请信。解题思路：1. 明确写作目的：邀请Jim进行线上经验交流。2. 内容要点：建议交流的具体内容（如写作技巧、常见错误）及其原因（帮助同学提高写作能力）；交流时间（如具体日期和时间段）和其他事项（如平台、设备要求）。3. 语法点：使用一般现在时和将来时，如'I suggest you focus on...'（虚拟语气建议），'The session could be held...'（委婉提议）。4. 词汇用法：'focus on'（专注于），'struggle with'（挣扎于），'work for'（对...合适）。5. 注意词数控制，开头结尾已给出，需补充正文。

questions.stem: 假定英语课上老师要求同桌之间交换修改作文，请你修改你同桌写的以下作文。文中共有10处语言错误，每句中最多有两处。每处错误仅涉及一个单词的增加、删除或修改增加：在缺词处加一个漏字符号(^)，并在其下面写出该加的词。删除：把多余的词用斜线(\)划掉。修改：在错的词下划一横线，并在该词下面写出修改后的词。注意：1．每处错误及其修改均仅限一词;2．只允许修改10处，多者(从第11处起)不计分。We all know that cycling is a greatly exercise. A doctor tells me people who lives the longest are dancers and cyclists. Maybe it is because the combination of fresh air, smooth movement and exercise. Whether you ride a bicycle, you don’t use petrol. So they are not producing carbon dioxide and not cause air pollution. Just see how cars have been taken over our cities. They often run at high speeds, what may put our lives in danger. And there were traffic jams, too. Our cities will be better places if we replace cars with bicycle.
questions.answer: 1. greatly → great; 2. lives → live; 3. because后加of; 4. Whether → When/If; 5. they → it; 6. cause → causing; 7. 去掉been; 8. what → which; 9. were → are; 10. bicycle → bicycles
questions.analysis: 本题考查短文改错，涉及形容词、主谓一致、介词、连词、代词、非谓语动词、语态、定语从句、时态、名词单复数等知识点。
